note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do lowercases every column and renames P09A01..P09A04, P9A05A1..A10 to cp_p09a01..cp_p09a04, cp_p9a05a1..cp_p9a05a10 (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, rows 209-222) labels each column, 14/14, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed question numbers (P09A01-P09A04; P9A05 rows 1-10). Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.10 (checked against the rendered page image), not the dictionary labels. Dictionary label defects not shipped: P09A03's variable label repeats P09A01's stem ('cómo considera que está la situación del país:') where the questionnaire reads 'cómo considera que está su situación y la de su hogar:'; P09A02's label has the typo 'mejroar'; value label 5 for P09A01 and P09A03 reads 'Igual' where the questionnaire prints 'Regular' (questionnaire shipped: 'Regular' for P09A01/P09A03, 'Igual' for P09A02/P09A04). Structure: P09A01-P09A04 each carry their own full stem -> section _1, no prompt; P9A05's shared lead-in 'Desde su punto de vista, en qué medida afecta cada una de las siguientes situaciones en el país:' -> section_prompt of section _2 (items are the terse row labels as printed, e.g. '¿Falta de agua potable?'). No whole-table instructions; interviewer lines 'Lea las opciones.' not shipped; the '1 - '/'2 - '/'3 - ' code prefixes in the P9A05 column headers stripped. Options as printed: P09A01/P09A03 1 ¿Muy buena? 2 ¿Buena? 3 ¿Mala? 4 ¿Muy mala? 5 Regular; P09A02/P09A04 1 ¿Mucho mejor? 2 ¿Mejor? 3 ¿Peor? 4 ¿Mucho peor? 5 Igual; P9A05 1 Afecta mucho 2 Afecta poco 3 No afecta en absoluto. NOTE the INE coding puts the middle category LAST: on P09A01-P09A04 resp 5 (Regular / Igual) is conceptually between 2 and 3, so resp 1-5 is not ordinal as stored. The do-file sets 97 (No sabe), 98 and 99 (No responde) to missing without dropping rows, so no DK code survives as a response here (unlike the avenues sibling's NS=3). Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 64/64 item x resp cells equal -- 50 valid cells (e.g. p09a01 1..5 = 110/1340/2812/1192/916; p09a02 178/1457/2181/686/1185; p9a05a1 1..3 = 5081/887/718; p9a05a10 5346/444/421) and 14 NULL cells each equal to the source's 97+99 count (p09a01 475+41=516; p09a02 1152+47=1199; p9a05a10 625+50=675). Live: 96,404 rows, 6,886 ids (= all Hogares rows), 96,404 distinct id-item, 6,424 NULL resp. Rights: INE Guatemala is the originator; no licence and no stated reservation on the ENCASBA page or questionnaire (bare copyright footer only); IRW's footing is the dictionary's 'Permission via Email'. Orchestrator ruling from batch_627 applies to the whole family: SHIP under SKILL.md 'silence is still permission'. No instrument_rights_register.csv row. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of INE Guatemala's Spanish questionnaire; on items cp_p09a01-cp_p09a04 the middle category (Regular / Igual) is coded 5, after the four ordered options, so resp is not ordinal as stored; don't-know and no-answer responses are NULL.
